name: Bluewater Key RV Resort
note: Owner-lot resort: 73 of its 81 privately owned lots are rented by the night through the resort office. A single night is possible only by phone within 7 days of arrival. Once checked in, an RV may not be driven in or out (only Class B vans may come and go). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site bluewaterkey.com (rates, policies, browse lots, for-sale pages) and its IRMng booking engine secure2.irm1.net/irmng?resort=5A, read 2026-10-30: the resort office sells nights online (pick dates, pick lot, pay a deposit; no application, owner approval or lease) on 73 rental lots (36 bayfront, 18 canal, 19 tropical) of the 81-lot owner-lot RV ownership park, full hookups, Class A/B/C motorhomes 16 ft+ allowed, nearly every lot 'Fits all sizes ... Motorhome' to 40-45 ft; engine priced 3-night stays May 11-14 2027 (11 lots free) and Jan 12-15 2027 (1 lot free); Google Maps open, phone, 4.4/585 -> real transient RV resort inside an owner-lot park, admitted under AWH's Keys owner-lot rule (2026-10-30); price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: Esri World Imagery (sat.py, 400-500 m frames at 24.6225,-81.6003 and 24.6205,-81.6004, rendered and read) shows the east row of lots (the resort's 'Bayfront' lots, 36 in the rental program, sold as Bayfront in the IRMng engine) backing onto a seawall with a private dock at each lot, the RVs about one pad-depth from the water, with no road, lot or treeline between; the water there is a dredged edge strip open along its whole length to the shallow open bay flats east of Saddlebunch Key (1+ km of open water in the 2.4 km frame), so those lots face open bay, not a canal. The west row ('Canal' lots) faces a ~20-25 m dredged canal with houses on the far bank (creekside-sized), and the 'Tropical' lots are interior. Bayfront earned by the east row.
fees_source: bluewaterkey.com/rates/ read 2026-10-30 (posted per-night rates by location and tier, 6 people, before Florida tax): Winter Nov 16 2026-Apr 30 2027 Tropical Silver $221 (cheapest; every tier fits a 23-ft motorhome) to Bayfront Platinum $361; Platinum Plus 'varies' (engine $210-350 in May 2027). Off-season: Fall Aug 1-Nov 15 2026 from $91, Summer May 1-Jul 31 2027 from $119. IRMng engine quote, 2 adults, Tue May 11-Fri May 14 2027, lot 14 Canal Platinum: Lot $567.00 (3 x $189, matching the posted summer rate) + 3.5% credit card fee $11.16 + tax $70.89 = $649.05; no resort or grounds fee. Jan 12-15 2027 only lot 32 Tropical Platinum was free, at $284 (the posted winter rate). Other fees: $25 one-time pet fee, $10/night for a third dog.

booking.note: 3-night minimum on every advance reservation (made more than 7 days before arrival), all year; 4 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th, Mini Lobster, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's (10% premium on the summer/fall holidays). Reservations made less than 7 days before arrival have no minimum, but must be made by phone at 305-745-2494: the online engine refuses a 1-night stay even then. Check-in 1-5 pm (Sun 1-4), no late arrivals, no arrivals on major holidays.

booking_source: https://bluewaterkey.com/rates/ (Minimum Stay Requirements, read 2026-10-30); IRMng engine test 2026-10-30: 1 night Jan 12 2027 -> 'Departure cannot be before January 15 2027', 1 night Nov 3 2026 (4 days out) -> 'Departure cannot be before November 6 2026'
flags: MINIMUM STAY, decide: a 3-night minimum applies to every advance booking all year (not just a peak season), and the online engine enforces 3 nights even for arrivals 4 days out. The rates page says 'Reservations made less than 7 days from arrival have no minimum stay requirement. Call the reservations office at 305-745-2494'. I treated that as the late-booking phone waiver (AWH 2026-10-19: a minimum 'avoided by calling ahead' is not a drop; SC state parks' within-a-week calls) and added. If AWH counts a waiver that needs a phone call inside 7 days, with winter nearly sold out (1 of 73 lots free on Jan 12-15 2027), as not enough, it is a skip as a standing 3-night minimum.

Owner-lot rental program: 73 of 81 lots (90%) are in the resort's rental program (bluewaterkey.com browse lots: 36 bayfront, 18 canal, 19 tropical; the same 73 lots in the engine). The resort office (Bluewater Key RV Ownership Park Property Owner's Association; reservations office 305-745-2494) runs the IRMng booking engine. Lots sell for $599,000-$1,150,000 on the resort's own for-sale page. Booking terms warn that a lot sale may occasionally cancel a reservation at the owner's discretion.

EKKO oddity: 'Once checked in, using your RV for transportation within or outside the resort is prohibited. Class B vans ... may come and go daily between 7:00 AM and 11:00 PM.' Whether an EKKO (Transit-chassis, sold as Class C) counts as a Class B van is the resort's call; otherwise EKKO stays parked for the whole stay with no way into Key West except a second vehicle, bike or taxi.
Price: cheapest in-season (winter) lot $221/night before tax; $91 in fall and $119 in summer. No resort fee; 3.5% credit-card fee on every transaction.

Other rules: self-contained RVIA-certified RVs at least 16 ft; no truck campers, pop-ups or hybrids; no late arrivals (gate closes 5 pm, 4 pm Sun) and no holiday arrivals; restricted dog breeds; no fire pits.
Quality: Google 4.4/585 (not poor). Not hurricane-closed: engine books 2026-2028 seasons.
